notes.title: SAE Alpha 0.1.2: Release Notes
notes.notes:
Read Relese Noten on our Website

After receiving a lot of useful information and bug reports in the first week after the release of the Early Access version, the following things have been changed:


XP for breaking crystals reduced to 100 to 220
Increased brightness in the jungle
World border added so that you can no longer fall off the map
Statistic "Coal Ores Mined" now works
Increased Durability on Items:
Iron Axe: 60 → 100
Iron Dagger: 50 → 100
Iron Pickaxe: 60 → 100
Iron Shovel: 15 → 40
Stone Axe: 30 → 60
Stone Dagger: 30 → 60
Wooden Spear: 15 → 30
Simple Lighter: 5 → 20
Flashlight: 10 → 50
Hammer: 10 → 40
Jumping into the water now works correctly and no longer deals fall damage

notes.title: The time has finally come - the release of SAE!
notes.notes:
The time has finally come - the release of SAE!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743962/b29b53f38ade60624fbdddd74d639f43ed3777ca.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743962/f5d33f49b3f8eedf055a38dae97cde18d59fe172.png

Hello folks!

No, you have not misread! SAE is actually being released in Early Access after a few delays!

Mark the date in your calendars: January 14th, 2025!

Yes, that's right, only one month to go!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743962/8351f7001d1ffa7defd4059e9b830a97eceda8e3.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743962/f5d33f49b3f8eedf055a38dae97cde18d59fe172.png

How much is still missing?

As you can easily see from the release date, not much is missing for the Early Access release. Basically, everything that needs to be finished is finished; there are just a few finishing touches to be made and tested!

Wishlist now!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743962/f5d33f49b3f8eedf055a38dae97cde18d59fe172.png

There will be more updates in the coming weeks!

Of course, we don't want to withhold anything from you. That's why there will be more updates in the near future.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743962/f5d33f49b3f8eedf055a38dae97cde18d59fe172.png

Free postcard!

To celebrate this very important stage, we have decided to offer the 2024 Edition postcards for free! This is because we no longer need them next year and there are still some left.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743962/3c8a571fc949198eec6a5b37fb37645a5e50ee2d.png

All postcards are handwritten and can also be SAE-stamped on request during the ordering process. Free of charge, of course!

Click here to get to our shop!

So pick one up now for free; only while stocks last!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743962/f5d33f49b3f8eedf055a38dae97cde18d59fe172.png

Get it before it's too late: Limited Edition Stingray Poster!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743962/16fd3499721a64a33018a2cccb61bdd0fabad20f.png

We have spared no effort to create a new poster, limited to 20 copies. Get your hands on one of the few posters showing the development of the Stingray at SAE. The poster is in A3 format (29.7 x 42.0 cm). Printed on high-quality, 250g/m2, glossy photo paper with vivid colors and crisp details. Our posters are sure to make a statement wherever they're displayed.

Click here to get one!

You too can decorate your room with a stingray!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743962/f5d33f49b3f8eedf055a38dae97cde18d59fe172.png

Thank You for reading!
